back.es: land, earth, ground (also soil, and Earth the planet); as a noun here: land, territory, one's homeland
back.example: This land belongs to my family.

note: The hint is about territory and homeland, but the example uses land as family property, where "el terreno" is also common; an example like "Extraño mi tierra." (I miss my homeland.) would match the hint better and keep the "soil" card clearly separate.
